fix: Vietnamese QR login text is encoded with Rust Unicode escapes.
Bundled Inter font glyph coverage was verified for all updated Vietnamese text.
A short-lived LAN pairing server replaces the external QR relay in the Brick launcher.
The LAN pairing server validates Host, Origin, PIN, session lifetime, callback redirect URI and OAuth state before PKCE token exchange.
QR pairing now uses opaque black-and-white raster modules with nearest-neighbor sampling for reliable phone scanning.
Local QR forms use a one-time nonce so mobile browsers that omit Origin can pair without accepting an incorrect Origin.
The one-time nonce and exact Brick Host are the local QR CSRF authority; Chrome QR hand-offs with non-canonical Origin or Fetch Metadata no longer require reloads.
After PIN validation, the Brick serves an automatic Spotify hand-off page with a Continue to Spotify fallback link instead of an empty HTTP redirect.
qr_config_default: intentionally empty legacy relay configuration; ignored while local QR pairing is enabled
